in_sanskrit.name: Firdosh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Victorious, Conqueror
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Firdosh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Firdosh is a powerful and victorious name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vardhana' which means 'to grow, expand, or increase'. It is a name of strength, signifying the conqueror within. It is believed that those named Firdosh are blessed with the courage to overcome adversity and the loyalty to keep their promises.
